tasks.description: Fix the deterministic HTML auditor so content inside inert <template> elements, including nested templates, is not counted as visible H1s, canonical links, image-alt violations or robots directives. Preserve visible markup outside templates, original audit rules and existing tests. Make a production-quality minimal fix with regression tests, without changing published services.

Extend Auvrora's deterministic noindex audit to recognize the standards-style <meta name="googlebot" content="noindex"> and <meta name="bingbot" content="none"> search-bot directives, case insensitively, while preserving existing generic robots handling and not flagging unrelated meta tags. Add a concise regression test. No external fetches or deployment.

Harden domain-validation errors so untrusted, extremely long or control-character-bearing brand/competitor domain inputs cannot be reflected verbatim into error messages/logs. Preserve DomainInputError, useful bounded feedback and valid host normalization. Add tests for oversized input, newline/control injection and normal invalid-domain feedback. No provider calls.
